A '''warp vortex stabilizer''' was a device used to ensure that a [[starship]] would not drop out of hyperspace at the wrong moment, which could cause a systemic destruction event&mdash;commonly referred to as "fireball."<ref name="MF 3D">''[[Star Wars: Millennium Falcon: A 3-D Owner's Guide]]''</ref>
